infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Tempo uses your calendar to schedule workouts around your life.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Tempo reads your calendar to schedule workouts around your life, and — only when you turn it on — adds your sessions to it.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsWriteOnlyAccessUsageDescripti: Tempo adds your scheduled workouts to your calendar when you turn that on.
infoPlist.NSRemindersUsageDescription: Tempo sends reminders before your scheduled workouts.
infoPlist.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Tempo sends reminders before your scheduled workouts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Tempo lets you attach progress photos to your measurements. Photos stay private to your account.

plugins.calendarPermission: Tempo needs calendar access to schedule your workouts.
plugins.remindersPermission: Tempo needs reminder access to send workout alerts.
